decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that improves the firm's core infrared heater line, so it is central to the announced efficiency direction, and having invested in its development, management would persist with it.

The plaque heater has its own website page, a visible public commitment within the firm's narrow core range, and with industry turnover growing management attributes any weakness to temporary causes and keeps it.
The luminous radiant heater builds directly on established gas infrared know-how and production, and the sunk investment and fit with the core line favor continuing it.
Tube heaters are a staple of hall heating, central to the firm's offer, so management stays committed despite limited visibility after 2019.
The standard plaque heater was featured on its own page and anchors the core range, so it is strongly justified to keep it.
Although it partly overlaps with Product D, this second tube heater variant reflects committed investment in the core line, so it is likely retained, if with somewhat more risk of consolidation.
